notes.title: Version upgrade
notes.notes:
【Time】: January 20, 2024

【Content】：Version upgrade

1. The upper limit of gun power is greatly increased

2. Holding gold coins is greatly improved

3. The upper limit of holding gold coins is greatly increased

4. The fishing value has been optimized and adjusted to improve the game experience. Come and try it~

5. Monthly sign-in, holiday gift packs, gifts from the God of Wealth, daily specials, special funds, VIP9 exclusive daily gift pack rewards, new double skill cards

6. Noble privilege treasure chests and luxury carousel rewards have been adjusted and optimized

7. The single consumption of diamonds for the mythical beast skills Suzaku and Qinglong is adjusted from 40 to 20 diamonds per day.

8. The new activity Endless Treasures is officially launched and can be viewed on the main interface icon.

9. Optimization and adjustment of gun multipliers and gold coin unlocking conditions for all levels

10. The difficulty of daily tasks and hunting competition tasks has been adjusted and optimized.

11. Strengthen the adjustment of the gun times dropped by new materials. The new materials required are adjusted from the original 500 million gun times to 1.4 billion gun times.

12. The upper limit of possession of Poseidon Cannon has been greatly increased.

13. The new background loading image has been updated and launched.

subsequent versions

1. BOSS-Blue Flame Candle Dragon will be online soon

notes.title: Version update
notes.notes:
【Time】: January 5, 2024

【Content】：Version update

1. The effect of the mythical beast skill Blue Dragon has been greatly improved; the diamond consumption per time is adjusted from the original 20 diamonds to 40 diamonds.

2. You can consume diamonds in any room to experience it.

3. The new activity National Treasure Hunt is officially launched

4. The new BOSS mysterious dwarf Huang is officially launched

5. Can be experienced in the fifth and sixth levels

6. The difficulty of difficult tasks in the Time and Space Treasure activity has been greatly reduced.

7. Fix known bugs

subsequent versions

1. White Tiger skills will be launched soon

notes.title: New upgrade of gold coin version
notes.notes:
【Time】: October 31, 2023

【Content】: New upgrade of gold coin version

1. Holding gold coins is greatly improved

2. The purchase of gift pack gold coins has been greatly increased

3. The purchase of gold coins in the mall has been greatly increased

4. Poseidon Field’s cannon times are greatly increased

5. The gold coins obtained by diamond warheads are greatly improved.

6. Optimization and adjustment of unlocking conditions for the gun multiplier at the level entrance

notes.title: Halloween event version
notes.notes:
【Time】: October 23, 2023

【Content】: Halloween version update

1. The upper limit of holding gold coins is greatly increased

2. The power of holding a gun is greatly increased

3. The new strengthening material (Sea Jade Lingshi) is officially launched

4. In the game, if you use 100 million gun times or more (excluding doubling skills) to kill high-power fish, there is a probability of dropping materials: Sea Jade Spirit Stone.

5. The new gift pack and enhanced material pack are officially launched and can be viewed in Value Benefits

6. The new Halloween gift pack is officially launched <can be viewed on the main interface

7. The new weird pumpkin weapon gift pack is officially launched and can be viewed in Weapons Specials

8. The new theme event Halloween is officially launched. You can view it in the activity center. Collect designated items and exchange for permanent wings "Golden Bat Magic Wings"

9. Fix known bugs

subsequent versions

1. Civet Goddess will be launched soon

notes.title: Mid-Autumn Festival version
notes.notes:
[Time]: September 25, 2023

1. The new BOSS Chang'e is officially online and can be experienced at the fourth, fifth and sixth levels.
2. The Auspicious Rui Rabbit is officially launched and can be experienced at the fourth, fifth and sixth levels.
3. A new theme event is launched during the Mid-Autumn Festival. Collect the specified number of mooncakes to exchange for exclusive Mid-Autumn wings - Qimeng Mid-Autumn Festival (permanent)
4. The new Mid-Autumn Festival gift pack is officially launched. You can check the Mid-Autumn Festival gift pack experience on the main interface.
5. The new Mid-Autumn Festival weapon special gift package is online, you can check the experience on the main interface of the weapon special discount
6. The new BOSS gift pack is now online
7. Significantly increase the number of gold coins obtained after using colored diamond warheads
8. Fixed the problem that the dragon boat turret has no fatal artillery.
9. Fix known bugs

subsequent versions

1. Phoenix Staff will be launched soon
